title: thlaspi cikaeum
intro: Thlaspi cikaeum, commonly known as the glaucous alpine cress, is a type of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Thlaspi cikaeum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic activities, which contribute to its use in alleviating symptoms of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Thlaspi cikaeum include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
